objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulation and process at a strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Locally defined regulation or regulation relating to a business process

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document describing specific procedures, process sequence, and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed documentation of specific work steps and sub-processes

objs.name: document
objs.description: Generic document object that can be of various types

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment subject to release cycle of main document

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information not subject to release cycle of main document

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed amendment to an existing document

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request to verify document validity at periodic intervals

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: author
objs.description: User role responsible for creating and authoring documents

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User role responsible for checking content accuracy

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for approving and publishing documents

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User role with view-only access to released documents

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role responsible for translating released documents

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with assigned permissions and roles

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Special user group with access to archived documents

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of new document object with selection of document type and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using integrated editor

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintenance of document metadata and attributes

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group and person-level authorizations to documents

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start of 3-step approval workflow consisting of Creator, Review, and Release

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by workflow participant completing their task

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document after release to make visible to readers

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of new version when revising released document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archiving when no longer relevant

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of amendment proposal for existing document

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of new version incorporating accepted Change Proposal

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation of continued document validity and update of valid until date

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Declaration that document is invalid and no longer available to users

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of authorizations and archiving of invalidated document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation and restoration of previously invalidated document

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Sending of document notification to assigned users and user groups

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow request for users to actively confirm document acknowledgement

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User confirmation of receipt and understanding of document

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content to another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Checking and validation of translated document

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval and publication of translated document version

o2o.description: Change Proposal belongs to and relates to Document
Validity Extension Request is linked to Document
Override Request is created for Document
Reactivation Request targets previously invalidated Document
Reader has view-only access to Document
User Group members are assigned read and change rights to Document
Archive Group retains access to archived Document
Guidelines define objectives and framework for Procedural Instructions
Work Instructions document detailed steps within Procedural Instruction framework
Attachment and Additional Info are distinct supplementary document types

o2e.description: Release workflow is initiated for Document
New version is created for Document
Change Proposal is created for Document
Document is distributed to User Group via email
Acknowledgement is requested from User Group
